observations: 32 full-body poses present in eight columns and four rows, with generous inter-sprite clearance and no visible cropped anatomy.

Eight-heading sequence is present, including genuine rear quarters, full rear and side-oriented torso/boot views.
Rising row has tucked knees/boots and lifted arms; descending row has boots lower beneath hips and arms lowered/outward. Silhouettes are distinguishable at source size.
Landing visibly lowers pelvis and deepens knees relative to anticipation while retaining head size and coat identity.
No weapons, props, baked magic, floor, ground shadow, labels or cell marks were visible.
visual_ambiguities: The stylized facial angle of front-quarter versus adjacent profile views is close, especially SE/E and W/SW; torso/coat-front width and boot orientation provide the stronger distinction. Exact small-scale directional readability is not established by this source-size review.
Long dark coat and fur collar naturally occlude some hip/knee detail and rear hands.
